string.text: Boss! Wagons greased, apples unbruised. How can I help?
Everything by the manifest, everything in place! Your orders?
Good to see you! Want to see how much we've traded? Spoiler: a lot.
Greetings, traveler! The caravan is bound for Manehattan, but we can spare a minute for a good pony.
Whoa! Make way for the trade caravan! Oh, it's just you. How can we help?
Good day! Cider, cloth, gems — everything but discounts. What do you need?
Hello, traveler! If Flim and Flam sent you — we're not buying anything.
You again? What else can we do for you?
Oh, we meet again! Equus is as cramped as a pumpkin cart.
Hello again! Forget something?
Good day, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}! {VILLAGER_PARTY_EXPLANATION}. {VILLAGER_STATE}
Oh, hello! Don't startle us like that, we've got fragile goods in the cart. {VILLAGER_PARTY_EXPLANATION}. {VILLAGER_STATE}
Greetings! The sun is shining, the princesses are where they should be — a good day. {VILLAGER_PARTY_EXPLANATION}. {VILLAGER_STATE}
Good day, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}! Horseshoes, swords, mane armor — how can I help?
Careful, it's hot! What are we forging today?
Ah, a customer! My hammer was getting bored. How can I help?
Hello! If you want lucky horseshoes, see the fortune teller. If you just want sturdy ones, see me.
Yes? What now?
Come to admire me? These chains don't suit me at all.
What do you want? If you brought a cupcake, speak up. If not, move along.
Need a sturdy pony in your company, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}? For {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} my hoof is yours.
Looking for somepony to serve. Can't beat a dragon, but a timberwolf — easily. The price is {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}.
Hey, captain! I'd like some work. {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} and I'll follow you into the Everfree itself.
Don't worry, I'll finish my cider and catch up.
Coming! Just let me finish my cupcake — you can't abandon a cupcake.
One second, saying goodbye to the tavernkeeper. We're best friends now.
Greetings, boss. {?SPEAKER.GENDER}Glad{?}Glad{\?} to see you. The street is watched, nopony's complaining.
Here's the boss! Business is good, coins are jingling. How can I help?
All quiet, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}. Even the guards don't drop by — we bring them cupcakes.
Good thing you're here, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}! Let's show them whose street this is!
Just in time! These upstarts think the street is theirs. Shall we convince them otherwise?
Hey, you! What are you doing here? This is our street.[if:convo_angry]
Lost, {?PLAYER.GENDER}gorgeous{?}handsome{\?}? Strangers aren't welcome here.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Stop. There's a toll for this alley. Kidding. Or not.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Don't talk to me. Talk to the boss.
I just stand here and look scary. All talk goes to the boss.
Greetings! Here for the tournament, I bet? The prize is worth it — even Rainbow Dash would be jealous!
Welcome to the arena! Tournament's coming up — get your hooves and helmet ready.
Greetings, friend. No tournament right now, but you can always warm up in the arena.
No tournaments in sight — all the champions left for the Equestria Games. But you can practice.
Good day! I can tell by your walk — you know which end of a sword to hold. How can I help?
New here? No, I can see it in your eyes — a seasoned fighter. What brings you to the arena?
Greetings, {PLAYER.NAME}! Back on the sand?
{PLAYER.NAME}! The crowd remembers you. Going out again?
Care for a new mane, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}? I can style it like Rarity's own!
Have a seat! Curls are in today, rainbows tomorrow. What shall we do?
The mane is a pony's face! Allow me to take care of your face.
Sorry, {?PLAYER.GENDER}poor thing{?}poor fellow{\?}, I only cut for coin. But I can lend you a comb.
May the princesses keep you, but I don't cut for free.
Ah. A fine game. As good as Twilight against Celestia.
Great game! Next time I'll beat you.
Greetings, {?PLAYER.GENDER}wanderer{?}wanderer{\?}! Know the game of {GAME_NAME}? I'm the best at it in these parts. Have a seat!
Hey, fancy a game of {GAME_NAME}? A favorite of the {CULTURE_NAME}{.g} folk. Loser buys the cider!
Your grace! What an honor! Care for a game of {GAME_NAME}? It's the favorite pastime of the {CULTURE_NAME}{.g} folk.
Your grace, a game of {GAME_NAME}? They say Princess Luna herself plays it at night.
Oh, hard times these days...
Ah, the cider used to be sweeter and the apples bigger...
May I be of service, your grace?
Your grace! Such an honor for us. How can I help?
Sorry, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}, I have to get home — Mom promised cupcakes. Anything else you need?
Excuse me, my parents are waiting. Maybe you need something else?
Good health to you! Can I help with anything?
Cheers! The cider here is excellent. Can I point you anywhere?
Sorry, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}, chores are waiting. Can I help with something?
In a hurry, in a hurry — I've got pies in the oven! What do you need?
Buddy, let's stay out of each other's way: there aren't enough cupcakes to go around here as it is.
Go somewhere else, pal. This is our spot — and our luck.
Nothing to give, sorry. May the princesses keep you.
I can barely scrape together enough for an apple myself... Good luck to you.
Move along. I'm on duty and I've got no coins. Celestia keep you.
No chatting on duty. Be on your way.
Get out of my sight, beggar![if:convo_angry]
Shoo! The Royal Guard doesn't give handouts![if:convo_angry]
There have been many complaints about you. Behave, or you'll be sent to the moon. Well, to the dungeon.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Ah, it's you. We're watching you. One wrong move and it's a cell for you.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Yes? What do you need?
Listening. Keep it short — I'm on duty.
In the name of the princesses — what do you want?
{SALUTATION}... You came for me! Now that's friendship!
{SALUTATION}! I knew you wouldn't leave me!
I don't know you, but thank you! You're a true hero of Equus.
Whoever you are — thank you! I owe you a cupcake.
Oh, hello. Another noble pony chasing glory? What's it all for, when you could just watch the sunset...
Hello. It's quiet here: no wars, no intrigue, just daisies and tea. Won't you stay?
Welcome, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}! The cider is fresh and the gossip is fresher. How can I help?
Come in, traveler! Apple pie today, just like Granny Smith's. Almost.
Greetings! The seat by the fire is free, and the rumors come at no charge. What'll it be?
Hello! If you're looking for mercenaries, they're in the corner. If it's adventure, that's in the corner too.
The usual?
Cider again? Coming right up!
Enjoying the fare, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}?
Everything tasty? Pinkie says our cupcakes are the second best in Equus!
Greetings. Got prisoners? I'll buy at a fair price.
Ah, you again. Brought prisoners? Show me.
Greetings, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}. You look like you know how to fight. Got a minute? We may have a common interest.
Psst... You look like somepony who takes prisoners. I have a business proposal for you.
What an honor, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}. A moment? I can offer you a valuable service.
Your grace! Prisoners are a burden, and I happen to relieve burdens. For gold, naturally.
Ah, a {?PLAYER.GENDER}friend{?}friend{\?} of my friends! Special prices for you. How can I help?
Friends of our friends are our friends! What are we buying?
Welcome, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}! The best goods in Equus, I swear on my cutie mark!
Come in, have a look! All fresh, all honest, almost like Applejack's.
Hello! Buying, selling, or just admiring?
Listen, {?PLAYER.GENDER}good pony{?}good pony{\?}, times are hard, but you're scaring off all my customers.
Move along, no handouts here. You're scaring the customers.
Hello, boss! Come to check how business is going?
Boss! Work is boiling, hooves aren't resting.
Well... How can I help, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}?
Good day! Lots of work, but there's a minute for you.
Hot in here, isn't it, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}? I need to get back to the anvil. How can I help?
Mind the sparks! Horseshoes won't forge themselves. What do you need?
Sorry about the smell, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}. A tannery is a tannery. How can I help?
Phew! Don't wrinkle your nose, you'll get used to it. How can I be of use?
I hope the smoke doesn't bother you, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}. The kiln has to be hot. How can I help?
Careful, fresh pots! You break it, you buy it. Kidding. Mostly.
I have a minute, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}. Time to check the fresh cider. How can I help?
Care to try the new cider? No? Then how can I help?
I have a minute, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}, the loom is waiting. How can I help?
This cloth was ordered by Rarity herself! Well, almost herself. What do you need?
Careful, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}, don't put a hoof under the press! How can I help?
Pressing oil, pressing juice! What brings you to us?
Pay no mind to the sawdust, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}. How can I help?
Knock knock! That's not a woodpecker, that's me. How can I help?
Greetings, traveler. I am {LORD.NAME}, everypony here knows me. And who might you be?
A new face in {EQ_SETTLEMENT}! I am {LORD.NAME}. How can I be of use?
Ah, {PLAYER.NAME}! Good to see you. What's new?
{PLAYER.NAME}, hello. How can I help?
Welcome to {EQ_SETTLEMENT}! I am {LORD.NAME}, the headman. A fine harvest this year — Applejack herself would approve.
Hello, traveler. I am {LORD.NAME}, I look after the village. What brings you here?
{PLAYER.NAME}! Come in, the pie has just come out of the oven.
Ah, {PLAYER.NAME}. How are things in the wide world? Here it's the same as ever: we sow, we plow, we drink tea.
Greetings! {LORD.NAME}, merchant. If anything is sold in {EQ_SETTLEMENT}, it goes through me.
A new customer? Wonderful! I am {LORD.NAME}. Friendship is friendship, but trade goes by receipt.
{PLAYER.NAME}! Good to see you. Got a profitable deal?
Ah, {PLAYER.NAME}! Prices keep rising, and you keep looking just as good.
Hello! I am {LORD.NAME}, a craftspony. My work is praised even in Canterlot.
Careful, fresh varnish! I am {LORD.NAME}. How can I help?
{PLAYER.NAME}! Stop by the workshop — I have a new piece.
Hi, {PLAYER.NAME}. Hooves are busy, but ears are free — go ahead.
Well, well. A new face. I am {LORD.NAME}, and every dark alley in {EQ_SETTLEMENT} is mine. What do you want?[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
The name's {LORD.NAME}. Around here ponies are my friends — if they want to sleep soundly.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
{PLAYER.NAME}. You again. I hope it's business.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Ah, {PLAYER.NAME}. Keep your voice down — the walls have ears, and the ears have my boys.
Peace be with you, traveler. I am {LORD.NAME}. The Sun and the Moon watch over this town.
Welcome. I am {LORD.NAME}, and I teach harmony. Would you like to hear about friendship?
May Celestia's sun shine upon you, {PLAYER.NAME}.
{PLAYER.NAME}! Luna saw you in a dream. A good sign.
Welcome to our lands! I am {LORD.NAME}. The fields here are mine, and so are the apples.
Hello! {LORD.NAME}, at your service. A big estate, many cares — tell me what brings you.
{PLAYER.NAME}! Good to see you. Perhaps you'll drop by the fair?
Ah, {PLAYER.NAME}. The harvest is ripening — the perfect time for business.
Hey there! I am {LORD.NAME}. I see you like the long roads too. Have a seat?
Hello, traveler. {LORD.NAME}, adventurer. I have a story — want to hear it?
Wow, a real commander's bearing! I am {LORD.NAME}. Wouldn't you be looking for a reliable pony for your company?
{PLAYER.NAME}! What brings you here?
At your command, captain!
{PLAYER.NAME}, I'm ready. Where are we going?
